# Glossary

Canonical one-line definitions for the vocabulary used across the corpus. Each term is defined **once, here**; guides and reading-paths link to this page (e.g. `glossary.md#family`) rather than redefining terms ([ADR-PC-022 §P3](../product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-022-product-documentation-architecture.md)). For the full treatment, follow the linked ADR or concept doc.

| Term | Definition |
|---|---|
| <a id="accrual"></a>**Accrual** | The periodic recognition of earned-but-unpaid interest; emitted as the `InterestAccrued` event. The maths is defined in the financial-concepts reference. |
| <a id="acl-anti-corruption-layer"></a>**ACL (anti-corruption layer)** | The boundary service that translates between the engine's domain model and a legacy/external system, isolating the engine from foreign shapes. Implemented per [ADR-IC-012](../integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-012-anti-corruption-layer-implementation.md). |
| <a id="bitemporality"></a>**Bitemporality** | Every projection row carries both *valid* time (`valid_from`/`valid_to`) and *system* time (`recorded_at`/`superseded_at`), so the engine can answer "what did we believe, as of when". Application-level on PostgreSQL per [ADR-PC-002](../product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-002-application-level-bitemporality.md). |
| <a id="commitment-catalogue"></a>**Commitment catalogue** | The registry of load-bearing invariants ("fitness functions") the engine must not silently drift from, each bound to a Test ID. The single source of truth governed by [ADR-PC-020](../product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-020-llm-toolchain-and-conformance-governance.md). |
| <a id="constitution"></a>**Constitution** | Opening a term deposit — the v1 flagship write path, run as an orchestrated saga (the constitution saga). |
| <a id="crypto-shredding"></a>**Crypto-shredding** | GDPR erasure by destroying a per-subject encryption key, rendering the ciphertext unrecoverable while structural fields stay cleartext. The engine's one managed-secret exception, per [ADR-PC-004](../product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md). |
| <a id="day-count"></a>**Day count** | The convention mapping a calendar period to an interest fraction (e.g. Act/360 for PT retail deposits); a pack-bound primitive, not hard-coded. |
| <a id="decider"></a>**Decider** | The per-family, command-side function that turns a command into events — running the financial-math kernel, resolving rate sheet + pack primitives, and appending. Family-owned, never in the generic engine, per [ADR-PC-021](../product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-021-application-layer-family-owned-deciders.md). |
| <a id="event-envelope"></a>**Event envelope** | The metadata wrapper carrying each event's identity, ordering, and the pinned `pack_version` / `schema_version` ([ADR-PC-009](../product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-009-per-instance-version-pinning.md)) — so an instance's governing schema+pack is answerable from its events alone. The business payload rides separately (the Avro record). |
| <a id="explicit-drift-gate"></a>**Explicit-drift gate** | The rule that no change may contradict an Accepted ADR without an amendment or supersession in the *same* change — divergence is allowed, silent divergence is not. Defined in [ADR-PC-020](../product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-020-llm-toolchain-and-conformance-governance.md) §D3. |
| <a id="family"></a>**Family** | A product family (e.g. `term_deposit`) — the unit of domain logic the engine hosts as a plugin. The engine is family-agnostic; adding a family is zero generic-engine diff ([ADR-PC-021](../product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-021-application-layer-family-owned-deciders.md)). |
| <a id="fold"></a>**Fold** | A pure, deterministic function that applies one event to aggregate state. Folds carry no clock, I/O, or randomness — the property the determinism gate enforces ([ADR-PC-010](../product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-010-dotnet-hand-rolled-engine.md)). |
| <a id="idempotency-key"></a>**Idempotency key** | The stable key (e.g. `event_id`, `correlation_id`) a receiver dedupes on so at-least-once delivery never double-applies an effect. One of the six integration primitives. |
| <a id="mcp-model-context-protocol"></a>**MCP (Model Context Protocol)** | The protocol by which the bank is exposed as a server of `tools`/`resources` to LLM agents (the agent channel). Runtime + SDK chosen in [ADR-IC-010](../integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-010-mcp-server-runtime-and-sdk.md); strategy in integration-concepts 11. |
| <a id="money-cents"></a>**Money / cents** | All money is an integer count of EUR cents (never a float), rounding HALF_EVEN exactly once at the `Decimal → Cents` boundary. Enforced by the Money analysers, per [ADR-PC-010](../product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-010-dotnet-hand-rolled-engine.md). |
| <a id="outbox"></a>**Outbox** | The transactional-outbox table written in the *same* local transaction as the event append, so an event and its publish-intent commit atomically. Mechanism in [ADR-IC-004](../integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-004-outbox-pattern-mechanism.md). |
| <a id="pack-regulatory-pack"></a>**Pack (regulatory pack)** | A `pt.YYYY.N` bundle of auditor-readable YAML data (primitives, parameters, rate-sheet refs, sealed test corpus) plus bundled CUE schemas, cosign-signed and distributed as an OCI artefact pulled by digest. Format in [ADR-PC-007](../product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-007-signed-yaml-oci-pack.md). |
| <a id="projection"></a>**Projection** | A read model derived by folding the event log, rebuildable at any time; the query side of CQRS. Bitemporal on PostgreSQL per [ADR-PC-002](../product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-002-application-level-bitemporality.md). |
| <a id="rate-sheet"></a>**Rate sheet** | Versioned, immutable pricing data resolved at constitution by an indexed point-in-time query; the resolved TAN is stamped onto the deposit and never moves. Storage + deploy API in [ADR-PC-008](../product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-008-rate-sheet-storage-and-deploy-api.md). |
| <a id="saga"></a>**Saga** | A multi-step flow with compensation (not distributed transactions); the hybrid orchestration + choreography model. Orchestrator in [ADR-IC-003](../integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-003-saga-orchestrator.md); walkthrough in integration-concepts 05. |
| <a id="snapshot"></a>**Snapshot** | A recomputable cache of aggregate state that speeds rebuilds but never replaces the log; advisory until proven by discard-and-rebuild drills. Per [ADR-PC-003](../product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-003-postgresql-snapshots.md). |
| <a id="sor-system-of-record"></a>**SoR (system of record)** | During coexistence, the authoritative owner of a given deposit (legacy core vs the engine); set at constitution and never flipped. Routing exposes the `sor`, not the routing logic ([ADR-PC-018](../product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-018-channel-routing-coexistence.md)). |
| <a id="strangler-fig"></a>**Strangler fig** | The incremental migration posture by which the engine takes over slices of a legacy estate without a big-bang cutover; the coexistence design. |
| <a id="tae-taeg"></a>**TAE / TAEG** | The effective annual rate (TAEG = the all-in comparison rate), derived from the cash flows; the financial-concepts reference defines the computation. |
| <a id="tan-taxa-anual-nominal"></a>**TAN (taxa anual nominal)** | The nominal annual interest rate, carried in basis points and resolved from the rate sheet at constitution. Distinct from the effective rate (TAE/TAEG). |
| <a id="variant"></a>**Variant** | A specific product configuration (YAML) an author writes, validated against a closed family schema with no DSL escape hatch (CUE; [ADR-PC-006](../product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-006-cue-schema-language.md)). |
| <a id="withholding"></a>**Withholding** | Tax withheld at source on interest (the `WithholdingApplied` event), applied flow-by-flow; the rule is in the financial-concepts reference. |
